name: Extended
description: Extended is a hybrid perpetual futures exchange: orders are matched off-chain and trades settle on Starknet, with settlement moving to Circle's Arc from 2026-10-22. USDC is the collateral, and the app takes deposits and withdrawals on several EVM networks and on Starknet.
description_zh: Extended 是一个混合式永续合约交易所：订单在链下撮合，交易在 Starknet 上结算，自 2026-10-22 起结算迁移到 Circle 的 Arc。USDC 是抵押品，应用支持在多个 EVM 网络和 Starknet 上存取款。

geo_site.method: GET /geo answers 451 for a restricted region and the app replaces itself with "Extended is not available in your region" (API error GLOBAL.NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_YOUR_REGION). The blocked countries are those where /geo answered 451 to the live probe (see the observations); the Restricted Countries page names 16 jurisdictions.

vpn.note: GET /geo answers 451 with the load balancer's error code VPN.

tos.restricted: Restricted Countries page: Afghanistan, Canada, Hong Kong, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Seychelles, Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia, the UK, the US

notes: Closed frontend. The app asks api.starknet.extended.exchange/geo on load; a 451 answer blocks the app, and the load balancer's error code tells a VPN from a restricted region. GET api.starknet.extended.exchange/geo answered {"status": "OK"} from Singapore, Brazil and France on 2026-10-12.
evidence: app.extended.exchange bundle: GET /geo, UnavailableForLegalReasons, LbErrorCode VPN, 'Extended is not available in your region'
